prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Your pet lives directly on your screen! Drag to move, right-click for settings, or press Alt+P to toggle visibility.", "Quick Shortcut: Alt + P toggles pet visibility."]
2: ["Pick Your Companion", "Choose Companion Species"]
3: ["Find Your Perfect Pet Match", "Answer two quick questions so we can recommend the ideal companion path for your desktop setup.", "What role should your desktop pet play?"]
4: ["Tip: Always sign in with the same account provider to keep your adopted pets safe."]
5: ["Setting Up Your Desktop Environment", "We are assembling your pet's animations and desktop triggers."]
6: ["Adopt Your Desktop Companion in Under 2 Minutes", "Bring an interactive pet to your taskbar in just a few clicks.", "Start 2-Min Setup"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Click your pet to play, drag it anywhere across your monitors, or right-click for controls and speech options.", "Start Playing"]
8: ["Processing your photos usually takes about 60 seconds. You can minimize this window anytime."]
9: ["Choose Your Adoption Path", "Pick a instant ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your own photos."]
